sources.usage: Existing story and exact three published2008 Figaro public-domain exterior originals; no other imagery.

facts.interiorDiameterWarning: This is the projection theatre interior, not the entire native external auditorium diameter.
facts.visibleArchitecture: Smooth white main hemisphere; separate ribbed telescope dome and raised sliding shutter; fluted curved auditorium wall/cantilevered underside; low curved foyer roof and sweeping corrugated ramp/access walls.

limitations: Only whole external boundary/entry are mapped, no separately signed dome centres or building parts. Estimate hidden partitions, observatory body centre, shutter state, fine dimensions, support positions and ramp grades from retained views. No interior/exhibit/statue/site reconstruction.
